scope: Local farm building artwork edits; retain the approved style and increase front visibility

items.referenceRole: Edit target: preserve its hand-painted materials and identity, change camera and functional front details
items.prompt: EDIT the attached existing farm building sprite. Keep its current warm hand-painted rustic game illustration style, natural materials, modest weathering, restrained brown linework and color palette. Preserve a genuine transparent alpha background. Reproject the building to a LOWER, FRONT-BIASED ELEVATED CAMERA about 25-30 degrees above horizontal. The vertical FRONT FACADE and its functional interior should occupy roughly 60-65% of the building's visible height. The visible roof should occupy at most 25-35%, not dominate the picture. Make front doors, windows and work areas larger and easier to identify at 48px. Front edge stays horizontal, no isometric side rotation. Keep the same compact 2x2 square tile footprint, full subject centered with bottom-center contact and at least 12% clear transparent margins. No ceramic roof tiles, curved tile rows, upturned eaves, ornamental ridge caps, flower garlands, decorative shop crests, text, letters, watermarks, scenery, ground plane, cast ground shadow, blur, glow or matte fringe. Do not flatten or erase the hand-painted material detail. Keep the red vertical timber cow barn, charcoal straight metal gable roof, cream X-braced doors and hay bales. Shorten the roof's projected depth considerably and increase the front wall. OPEN ONE of the large barn doors slightly: a friendly small HOLSTEIN COW HEAD and a little neck/forequarters peek out from the doorway, ears and pink muzzle clearly visible, remaining mostly inside the barn. The cow belongs inside this building, not a separate animal placed outside. Natural small farm-animal eyes, no giant mascot face. Large barn doors and the peeking cow are the visual identity.
